company.name: Wiremind
company.summary: Wiremind是一家总部位于巴黎的技术公司，为客运交通运营商以及赛事和体育票务行业提供收益管理、库存和分销软件。公司成立于2014年，在12年自筹资金增长后首次进行外部融资。

evidence_refs.quote: Wiremind co-founders Colin Girault-Matz, the company’s CEO, and Charles Pierre, its CTO, remain majority shareholders and retain control of the business following the transaction.

employees

The Paris-based technology company plans to use the financing to accelerate its international expansion and increase investment in artificial intelligence as it seeks to become a major technology partner for passenger transportation operators and the event and sports ticketing industries.
Since the company’s founding in 2014, it has been completely self-financed, while also being profitable.
Wiremind has raised €35 million in its first external funding round, bringing in IronWave, formerly Wendel Growth, Bpifrance through its Large Venture fund, and Seaya Andromeda as new investors.

products.name: CAYZN
products.description: AI-First收益管理系统，用于客运交通运营商，帮助管理收益、运力、库存和分销。

evidence_refs.quote: CAYZN is the market leading, AI-First revenue management system for passenger transport operators.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Wiremind能否将其在客运交通收益管理领域已验证的盈利增长和客户基础，成功复制到南美、中东和亚太等国际市场，并在现有优化和机器学习基础上叠加生成式AI以提升产品竞争力。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：2025年收入增长67%、客户超过80家、CAYZN年度经常性收入增长81%、EVENTORI增长140%且分析超过200万张票务、公司自2014年以来完全自筹资金且持续盈利。证据边界在于：国际扩张和生成式AI功能仍处于计划或开发阶段，尚未产生收入或客户验证；来源未披露本轮估值或具体财务条款。
